text: Put each JSON value in a box that refuses to open past a safe depth.
rationale: A tower of boxes cannot knock over the whole report.

text: Teach the number reader to label giant counting strings instead of trying to hold them.
rationale: An enormous number becomes a harmless note rather than a crash.

text: Give every file its own bad-input basket so one mischievous receipt cannot hide the others.
rationale: The report can keep counting well-behaved files.

text: Walk deep JSON with a little notebook instead of climbing the computer’s stairs.
rationale: A notebook survives trees that are too tall for recursion.

text: Let the printer swap terminal-breaking characters for tiny escaped picture codes.
rationale: The report remains printable even with strange names.

text: Place a friendly gate before every decoded string and number, with a clear sign when it is too large.
rationale: Oversized pieces are turned into understandable diagnostics before they cause trouble.
